key.hydros_bundles.quick_stack: Bundle Routing: Quick stack into bundles
message.hydros_bundles.inventory_busy: Bundle Routing: finish the carried inventory action first
message.hydros_bundles.inventory_full: Bundle Routing: not enough inventory space
screen.hydros_bundles.title: Bundle Routing
screen.hydros_bundles.no_bundles: No bundles found in your inventory
screen.hydros_bundles.hint: Click a stack to move it in or out of the bundle
config.hydros_bundles.title: Bundle Routing Settings
config.hydros_bundles.settings_hint: Choose what goes into each named bundle without item IDs or rule syntax
config.hydros_bundles.item_search.hint: Search by the normal in-game item name…
config.hydros_bundles.priority_changed: Routing priority updated — top routes are checked first
config.hydros_bundles.choose_items: Choose a preset or click individual items for this bundle
config.hydros_bundles.error.bundle_name: Every route needs the exact anvil name of its bundle
config.hydros_bundles.error.no_items: Choose at least one preset or individual item for every route
config.hydros_bundles.category.quick_sta: Controls how the quick-stack key moves inventory stacks into bundles.
config.hydros_bundles.category.routing.d: Ordered rules assign item types to custom-named bundles. The first matching rule wins.
config.hydros_bundles.category.interface: Controls the bundle browser and action messages.
config.hydros_bundles.enabled.tooltip: The bundle browser remains available when quick stacking is disabled.
config.hydros_bundles.include_hotbar.too: Allows the quick-stack key to move non-bundle hotbar stacks.
config.hydros_bundles.action_delay.toolt: A small delay is safer on latency-sensitive multiplayer servers.
config.hydros_bundles.max_transfers.tool: Stops a routing loop or very large operation from sending unlimited inventory actions.
config.hydros_bundles.prefer_filled.tool: Consolidates items before filling another bundle with the same name.
config.hydros_bundles.name_match.tooltip: Exact uses the whole anvil name; Contains allows extra text around the configured name.
config.hydros_bundles.case_sensitive.too: Disabled by default, so “Blocks” and “blocks” are equivalent.
config.hydros_bundles.unmatched.tooltip: Choose whether unmatched stacks stay put or use a general-purpose bundle.
config.hydros_bundles.rules.help: Syntax: bundle name = selectors. Use $blocks, $redstone, minecraft:item, #namespace:tag, namespace:* or wildcards. Prefix a selector with ! to exclude it. Example: stone = minecraft:*stone*, !minecraft:redstone
config.hydros_bundles.rules.duplicate: More than one rule targets bundle name “%s”; combine their selectors instead.
config.hydros_bundles.notify_skipped.too: Includes stacks that had no suitable matching bundle.
config.hydros_bundles.show_inventory.too: Lets you click inventory stacks directly into the selected bundle.
